title: FIDA Global: 13+ Years of IT Innovation in Sri Lanka
excerpt: FIDA Global (Private) Limited has been at the forefront of IT and technological innovation for over 13 years, starting in 2011 with just two staff members.
content:
FIDA Global (Private) Limited has been at the forefront of IT and technological innovation for over 13 years. Starting in 2011 with just two staff members focused on IT Physical Infrastructure Solutions, the company has grown by over 300% year-on-year to become a leading provider of Business e-HRM solutions, ERP systems, IT Infrastructure solutions, and IT consultancy services.


The company's journey has been marked by continuous innovation. In 2012, FIDA Global expanded into business software systems with the birth of Profit Plus ERP, solving most business needs of Small and Medium Business Operations. The HRM module was later developed from customer demand, evolving into the comprehensive Smart HRIS platform that now serves manufacturing, logistics, banking and finance, healthcare, and hospitality sectors.


Today, FIDA Global offers state-of-the-art technologies including Cloud, Mobile, IoT, and enterprise software solutions. Their client base ranges from SMEs to multinational corporations in Sri Lanka and globally. The company is headquartered at No. 215 C, Raththanapitiya, Boralesgamuwa, 10290, Sri Lanka.


With a mission to satisfy customers by providing world-class innovations, products, and services with Social Responsibility, FIDA Global continues to be the Business Partner for Success & Beyond.


Author: FIDA Global Team
